title: VoltPilot additional measurement desired state
x-identity-rule: The three topic identity segments MUST byte-equal the payload identity fields.
x-revision-rule: Revision is monotone per device. Edge applies the complete document atomically and ignores older/equal revisions.
x-point-key-rule: point_key is unique within selections. The edge keys its poll plan on it and rejects a duplicate outright, so two components observing the same register arrive as ONE entry carrying the fastest requested cadence. ONE exception, additive and sent ONLY to a box that reports the capability measurement_config_per_component (edge-supports.md, AP-07 IP-18b Teil 2): a SHARED POINT - the same point_key appears once per component, EVERY occurrence names an entity_id and no component appears twice; each occurrence carries its own component's cadence. Such a box reads the point once per target (at the fastest cadence of its occurrences) and sends one sample per component with that entity_id (mqtt-measurement-samples-2.1.md section 2). If any occurrence of a point_key lacks entity_id, the uniqueness above holds for all of them. Uniqueness across array items cannot be expressed in JSON Schema, so the document shape is unchanged and schema_version stays 2.0; every box without the capability keeps receiving the merged plan byte for byte.
x-registerbilder-rule: OPTIONAL and additive (UEMS AP-05, wago-registerbild.md section 2). The per-plant parameters of a VoltPilot-Registerbild WAGO v1, one entry per WAGO controller, named by ONE of its card components (entity_id; unique within the array). The edge resolves that component to its connection target like any selection (x-entity-id-rule) and reads the card points of that target from base address + card offset with this function code and word order; karten lists the Soll in image order (card n = karten[n]) and karten.length equals kartenzahl, which is ALL cards in the image. steckplatz and kartentyp are the card identity and are always checked; variante and controller_kennung are checked ONLY when present - absent means not surveyed, never 0. The cloud sends the field only for a plan that carries WAGO card points; every other plan stays byte for byte as before, and schema_version stays 2.0. A box whose core predates the field refuses the whole document (unknown field) - it cannot read these points either, because its palette lacks the cards and refuses the catalog_version first.
x-entity-id-rule: OPTIONAL and additive (Geraeteseite Stufe 3b). It names the component the selection belongs to and is present only where that binding is unambiguous; absent means the plan belongs to the device as a whole and is read over the primary inverter's connection (the pre-3c behaviour, so an older cloud is unchanged). Since Stufe 3c the edge RESOLVES it: entity_id -> the per-entity registry pin edge_source_id -> a source in the retained edge/sources/config, whose connection the point is then read over; a pin naming the primary (the reserved source id 'inverter') and a platform-composed component without a pin (battery-hybrid / grid-meter / house-load, which ARE the primary's own channels) resolve to the primary. A binding the edge cannot resolve - unknown component, a pin naming a source this box does not publish, or any other component without a pin - is REFUSED with reason binding_unavailable and never read against the primary. An OCPP measurand carries no connection, so a binding neither selects nor refuses one there.
